import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_name} - Invitation
{event_name}
Date: {date_of_event}
{description_of_event}
{notes_block} """ def create_invitation_for_event( event_name: str, description_of_event: str, date_of_event: str, notes_for_event: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- event_name : str The name or title of the event. description_of_event : str A comprehensive description (may contain line breaks). date_of_event : str The scheduled date for the event. notes_for_event : str Extra information or instructions. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS. escaped_name = html.escape(event_name, quote=True) escaped_desc = html.escape(description_of_event, quote=True) escaped_date = html.escape(date_of_event, quote=True) # If notes are provided, escape and wrap them in a div. if notes_for_event: escaped_notes = html.escape(notes_for_event, quote=True) notes_block = f'
Notes: {escaped_notes}
' else: notes_block = '' # Populate the template. invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_name=escaped_name, description_of_event=escaped_desc, date_of_event=escaped_date, notes_block=notes_block ) return invitation_html
